instrument: name-only; identical string for both populations
scoring: resolved to an ID, not a string: SEC employer -> CIK; scholar affiliation -> OpenAlex institution id with lineage containment. Only OpenAlex publishes hierarchy, which favours the scholar arm.
pooling_rule: Reported per population and NEVER pooled. The two oracles differ in strength: a filing versus OpenAlex last_known_institutions, which lags a move. A gap is coverage x oracle freshness.
